# use-os

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse os facade.

## Facade links

- Canonical facade crate page: https://rustuse.org/use-os/
- Facade overview page: https://rustuse.org/facades/use-os/

- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-os
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-os/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-os/llms-full.txt. The /facades/use-os/ routes serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
